items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The names say what they do (compile_json_path_final_key, HasKeyOrArrayIndex) and the new hook has a clear comment. Formatting matches the surrounding code.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Behaviour can be overridden through one hook, and a small subclass handles array-index callers. It reuses compile_json_path, copies no logic, has no per-backend branches and leaves no debug code behind (the temp test file was removed).

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: json.dumps(key_transform) quotes and escapes the key correctly, and splitting off the last key with *rhs_key_transforms, final_key is safe. No exceptions are swallowed and no magic constants are added.

items.name: Array-index semantics kept for isnull / exact=None paths
items.name_zh: isnull / exact=None 路径保留数组下标语义
items.evidence: The last has_key key is now always compiled as an object key in the HasKeyLookup.as_sql path shared by SQLite, MySQL and Oracle. KeyTransformIsNull.as_sqlite/as_oracle and KeyTransformExact.as_oracle use HasKeyOrArrayIndex, so ints there are still array indices. Intermediate path segments are unchanged.
